topic: Uploading data to S3 bucket permissions
summary_markdown:
The primary discussion revolved around the technical difficulty of uploading generated data files (JSON format) into a specific S3 bucket path: `s3://jcd-dev-datacorp-partners/`. Multiple attempts by [me] and [p1] to upload or list contents in subfolders like `/allunite_test/dk/data/2021/02/` resulted in repeated `AccessDenied` errors.

It was determined that the required permissions might be limited solely to writing (uploading) data, as reading object lists was restricted. The files contained processed sensor data for a specific date range (February 15-21).

[p1] confirmed attempting the upload and reported back on the result.
decisions: The required data format is JSON, containing processed sensor data.
Data needs to be uploaded to the `s3://jcd-dev-datacorp-partners/allunite_test/dk/data/2021/02/` path.
action_items: Follow up on the successful upload of data files into the designated S3 bucket location.
